mapper.select: SELECT cursor_id FROM ai_event_cursor WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_event_cursor (owner_id,cursor_id) VALUES (#{owner},#{cursor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cursor_id=#{cursor}
mapper.select: SELECT owner_id,task_id,session_id,question_id,answer_id,root_question_id,generation,generated_question_id,created_at FROM ai_follow_up WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_follow_up SET generated_question_id=#{questionId} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND generated_question_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id})
SELECT FROM ai_attempt WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_attempt WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_number
SELECT FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','VALIDATING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 20

SELECT t.id,t.owner_id,t.purpose,t.status,t.revision,t.title,t.provider,t.model,t.currency, NULL AS manifest_json,t.manifest_hash,t.configuration_fingerprint,t.authorization_epoch,t.current_attempt_id, t.attempt_count,NULL AS candidate_json,t.error_code,t.created_at,t.updated_at FROM ai_task t JOIN ai_attempt a ON a.owner_id=t.owner_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.id=t.current_attempt_id WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.scope_authorization_id=#{authorizationId} AND t.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','VALIDATING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY t.created_at,t.id LIMIT 20
SELECT FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND status='QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND status IN ('RUNNING','VALIDATING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','VALIDATING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency=#{currency} AND fee_status IN ('REPORTED','RECONCILED') AND budget_date=#{date} THEN accounted_micros ELSE 0 END),0) AS reported_micros, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency=#{currency} AND fee_status='RESERVED' THEN reserved_micros ELSE 0 END),0) AS reserved_micros, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency=#{currency} AND fee_status='UNKNOWN' THEN reserved_micros ELSE 0 END),0) AS unknown_micros, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency<>#{currency} AND (fee_status IN ('RESERVED','UNKNOWN') OR (fee_status IN ('REPORTED','RECONCILED') AND budget_date=#{date})) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS unaccountable_count FROM ai_attempt WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND (fee_status IN ('RESERVED','UNKNOWN') OR (fee_status IN ('REPORTED','RECONCILED') AND budget_date=#{date}))
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,mode,target_item_id,target_version_id,created_at FROM ai_candidate_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}

SELECT s.task_id,s.source_item_id AS item_id,s.source_version_id AS version_id, s.source_version_number AS number,s.source_title AS title, CASE WHEN i.id IS NULL OR v.id IS NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.status='ARCHIVED' THEN 'ARCHIVED' WHEN i.status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.current_version_id=s.source_version_id THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'SUPERSEDED' END AS state, i.kind FROM ai_knowledge_source s LEFT JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=s.owner_id AND i.id=s.source_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.source_item_id AND v.id=s.source_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.task_id,s.ordinal

SELECT s.task_id,s.source_item_id AS item_id,s.source_version_id AS version_id, s.source_version_number AS number,s.source_title AS title,s.source_kind AS kind,s.ordinal FROM ai_preparation_source s WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id IN #{id} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id AND d.status='ADOPTED') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id AND d.status='ADOPTED')) ORDER BY s.task_id,s.ordinal

SELECT s.task_id,s.excerpt_id,s.ordinal FROM ai_material_draft_source s WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id IN #{id} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id AND d.status='ADOPTED') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id AND d.status='ADOPTED')) ORDER BY s.task_id,s.ordinal
SELECT owner_id,task_id,session_id,question_id,answer_id,evaluation_task_id FROM ai_training_draft_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id IN #{id} ORDER BY task_id

SELECT task_id,source_item_id AS item_id,source_version_id AS version_id, source_version_number AS number,source_title AS title,source_kind AS kind,ordinal FROM ai_preparation_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT task_id,excerpt_id,ordinal FROM ai_material_draft_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT task_id,excerpt_id,ordinal FROM ai_material_qa_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,target_question_id,target_version_id,created_at FROM ai_question_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,mode,target_item_id,target_version_id,created_at FROM ai_expression_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,content_json,tasks_json,created_at FROM ai_preparation_plan_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT owner_id,task_id,candidate_id,status,relation_id,content_json,created_at,supplement_id FROM ai_relation_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND candidate_id=#{candidateId}

SELECT s.task_id,s.source_item_id AS item_id,s.source_version_id AS version_id, s.source_version_number AS number,s.source_title AS title,s.source_kind AS kind,s.ordinal, CASE WHEN i.id IS NULL OR v.id IS NULL OR i.kind<>s.source_kind THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.status='ARCHIVED' THEN 'ARCHIVED' WHEN i.status<>'ACTIVE' OR i.current_version_id IS NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.current_version_id=s.source_version_id THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'SUPERSEDED' END AS state FROM ai_relation_source s LEFT JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=s.owner_id AND i.id=s.source_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.source_item_id AND v.id=s.source_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY s.ordinal

SELECT owner_id,task_id,candidate_id,status,relation_id,content_json,created_at,supplement_id FROM ai_relation_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND relation_id=#{relationId} AND status='ADOPTED' AND supplement_id IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{relationId})

SELECT s.task_id,s.source_item_id AS item_id,s.source_version_id AS version_id, s.source_version_number AS number,s.source_title AS title, CASE WHEN i.id IS NULL OR v.id IS NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.status='ARCHIVED' THEN 'ARCHIVED' WHEN i.status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.current_version_id=s.source_version_id THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'SUPERSEDED' END AS state, i.kind FROM ai_question_source s LEFT JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=s.owner_id AND i.id=s.source_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.source_item_id AND v.id=s.source_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.task_id,s.ordinal

SELECT s.task_id,s.source_item_id AS item_id,s.source_version_id AS version_id, s.source_version_number AS number,s.source_title AS title,s.source_kind AS kind,s.ordinal FROM ai_preparation_source s JOIN ai_expression_decision d ON d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id AND d.status='ADOPTED' WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.task_id,s.ordinal
